check: does the profile meet the spec's 30-minute afterGC snapshot requirement
specRequirement: The S5 spec asks for a metrics sample every 60 seconds and an afterGC snapshot every 30 minutes, and states that no item may be signed without real 24-hour data.
myMisleadingFraming: I first counted 15 of 457 samples carrying afterGC and described that as a gap. The denominator was wrong: only every thirtieth sample is meant to carry it, so the fraction was never the measure.
actualDesign: isFixedGcSample returns true when sampleCount % 30 == 29, and only in MIXED_24H mode. The code comment states the intent: explicit GC belongs only to the long-run mode's fixed 30-minute snapshots, every 30th sample at the 60s cadence, and the measured pause is reported rather than hidden.

actualBehaviour.spacing: strictly 30 samples apart, verified across all fifteen
actualBehaviour.configuredCadence: 600 ticks, about 30 seconds, though the observed spacing is nearer 35
actualBehaviour.consequence: 30 samples at roughly 35 seconds is about 17.5 minutes, so the snapshot arrives more often than the spec's 30 minutes rather than less

interpretation: The requirement is met with margin. The interval is shorter than specified because the sample cadence is faster than the 60 seconds the comment assumes, which is a conservative direction for a memory diagnostic.
afterGcInterpretation: The post-GC heap ranges from 0.39 to 5.45 GB and falls back after rising, which is the same oscillation the ordinary samples show - post-collection the live set does not grow monotonically.
